note: P is one design four times: a tapered lamp on the left with brass or steel caps, a dark glass panel of heat/blob sliders and four swatches on the right, and a glowing pink/orange palette. Q ranges widely: a squat bell jar with a bottom dock, a giant globe, a lamp in a room scene with a shelf and plant, and a full-width bottle with a toggle and time controls. R mostly repeats the tall rocket-style lamp, but it varies the layout (centred dock, side panel) and one lamp is a round bulb shape.
